::: {.remark .notes}

@thm-mixture-posterior has the form of [Bayes' theorem](probability-basics.qmd#thm-bayes),
with densities in place of some probabilities:
the prior probability $w_c$ of component $c$
is multiplied by the component density ${\p_c}(x)$ at the observation
and divided by the overall density ${\p_{\text{mix}}}(x)$,
which plays the role of the [law of total probability](probability-basics.qmd#thm-total-prob).

:::
